request:
Create a professional fantasy RPG creature source TURNAROUND sheet for the SAME single character named SLAG CRAWLER, 5 clearly separated directional views. This is source art for a small isometric ground enemy, so strict registration and identical anatomy across all panels matter above all. Wide landscape canvas, 3 columns by 2 rows, one complete centered creature per occupied cell, generous transparent gutters, all views approximately equal size, identical flat ground plane and same orthographic camera 24 degrees ABOVE, no horizon.
TOP LEFT: strictly facing RIGHT, pure side profile, snout at right, tail tip at left. TOP CENTER: facing LOWER-RIGHT, three-quarter FRONT view, see left side of animal and full blunt face. TOP RIGHT: HEAD ON directly toward camera, face visible, symmetrical, both front feet. BOTTOM LEFT: facing UPPER-RIGHT, three-quarter REAR view, rump nearest camera, head points away to upper-right. BOTTOM CENTER: STRAIGHT REAR view directly away from camera, centered tail points DOWN toward the viewer from rump, head HIDDEN. BOTTOM RIGHT: leave completely EMPTY. No text, no labels, no shadows on ground, no background, transparent PNG.
Design the creature as a magnificent compact stocky quadrupedal basalt pangolin/armadillo built out of organic volcanic scutes. LOW silhouette, width about 1.8 x height in profile, stout weight-bearing jointed legs (exactly four, crocodile/armadillo stance), three short pale worn claw tips per foot, segmented tapered slightly curved tail, beaked bulldog-like chisel muzzle with heavy brow, single glowing amber eye on each side; well-articulated jaw, small dark nostril. Broad protective carapace made of 5 large overlapping arch-shaped, hooked basalt plates that transition into progressively smaller tail scutes, intentional memorable silhouette; two small ivory cheek spurs. Blue-black volcanic rock with slate-blue highlights and small warm copper/ochre weathering along a few chipped edges. Tiny narrow orange-amber light from between scutes, NOT a pool of lava. Avoid spikes everywhere, no horns of a dragon, no wings, no beetle outline, no red lava stripes, no bright aura or bloom. Polished hand-painted two-dimensional dark-fantasy art for an isometric action RPG, crisp angular edges, readable interlocking light-and-shadow masses, strong cool highlights on the upper left, sparse fine cracks, richly detailed but readable at 100px. A unified dimensional 2D PAINTING (not 3D render, not pixel art, not flat icons). Rear views must actually show back, tail, hind legs with proper foreshortening. All 5 views must have own separate silhouettes, never touching; whole feet and whole tail present on each view. Empty sixth panel.
